fixed_xyz_review.rationale: The four exocyclic CH₂ groups are planar, Alternating ring bonds and an exocyclic π bond recur in all four ligands. Use two NCS⁻ and Ni(II), Each of the four neutral ligands is represented by a quinonoid radical limit centred on the ring N. Spin can delocalize between the ring and methylene. The four local symbols do not determine total multiplicity. In the triplet calculation most positive spin density resides on the four exocyclic carbons, This supports ligand spin delocalization; The solution shows substantial spin contamination
fixed_xyz_review.reference_scope: A conditional Lewis limiting form consistent with the original atoms, coordinates and net charge
fixed_xyz_review.electronic_state_evidence: Original coordinates fixed, PBE/def2-SVP gives E(UKS triplet) − E(RKS closed-shell singlet) = -9.71 kcal/mol. The triplet solution has ⟨S²⟩ = 3.106, An ideal pure triplet has ⟨S²⟩ = 2, Spin contamination adds uncertainty to the energy comparison. The total spin also depends on spin coupling, the functional and other accessible states; Original input multiplicity 1 recorded separately
